title: Tribulation Destroys the Rabble
summary: Ye Fan studies the Three Seals and works out that they must be used in sequence: Heaven Overturning to bind, Mountain Embracing to crush, Human King to kill. Yan Yunluan, healed by Xiao Mingyuan with Xiao family arts, comes back with Mingyuan for revenge. Ye Fan tests the combined seals on Yan. Yan breaks through mid-fight and conjures a heavenly-tribulation thunder bell, but Ye Fan hijacks the tribulation to break into Dragon Transformation himself. When Xiao Mingyuan tries to blood-sacrifice Lu City's people to summon Xiao clan elders, Ye Fan kills him, even though Mingyuan says his clan is allied with the Wang family of the Northern Plains. Yu Die promises to smooth things over, and she and Dongfang Ye offer to help find a Dragon Transformation scripture in the Immortal Palace realm. At another entrance they find Duan De running a scam. Ye Fan catches him in a formation prepared by 'a mighty being', and Dongfang Ye strips him of his loot, including King Yuhua's Nine Divine Weapons.
